meta_description:
elenacardone on October 20, 2026: "So proud of my husband, Grant Cardone, and the launch of @sbagov Million Dollar Pitch! 💰

It was an honor to be at the National Archives for this special premiere. Grant has always believed in the power of entrepreneurs and the importance of helping business owners reach their full potential.

Watching him create opportunities for entrepreneurs to grow, scale, and achieve their goals makes me incredibly proud.

Congratulations, Grant! 🇺🇸❤️

Special thanks to my favorite designer @nardosdesign for the fabulous outfit tonight!".
